title: Kanwar Lake Bird Sanctuary
tagline: Kanwar Lake (Kabar Taal) — Asia’s Largest Freshwater Oxbow Lake & Ramsar Wetland

heroImage.alt: Kanwar Lake Bird Sanctuary - Eurasian Sparrowhawk at Kanwar Lake

overview.short: Kanwar Lake (Kabar Taal) in Begusarai is Asia’s largest freshwater oxbow lake and Bihar’s first Ramsar wetland, hosting over 106 species of winter migratory waterfowl.
overview.description: Formed as a residual oxbow meander of the Burhi Gandak River, Kabar Taal spans 67.5 square kilometers in Begusarai district. Designated as a Ramsar Wetland in 2020, this aquatic haven shelters critically endangered vultures, eagles, red-crested pochards, and the ancient Jaimangalgarh island temple.
overview.about: A peaceful wetland wonderland where country boats glide through lotus-filled waters, reed beds, and historic island mounds.

howToReach.roadNote: Accessible via SH-55 from Begusarai and NH-31 from Patna.
